integrity: The finite-rank eigenvalues are established background. The claimed new content is the growing-rank spectral-power trace expansion, the critical shape cancellation and the explicit triangle constant. No independent audit or priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed dimension, positive Dirichlet parameters and real power; the full text of one closely related historical differential-asymptotic study was inaccessible, so unindexed equivalence remains a priority risk. Finite checks do not prove the infinite asymptotics.
title: Spectral-power trace cancellation for Dirichlet Bernstein–Durrmeyer operators on simplices
